dynamics_verdict.message: pocket shows measurable dynamics (volume/SASA/mouth fluctuate well above the noise floor; analysis verified sane).

anm_comparison.note: ANM apo(1W60) pocket-vs-global fold-change is 0.857; the MD fold-change here is pocket-vs-background Cα RMSF on 1AXC. Different references — compare qualitatively only.

caveats: 1AXC exploratory MD; short timescale. No 8GLA positive control in this run.
Convex-hull volume is an approximate proxy, not an absolute cavity volume.
RMSF/SASA fluctuation shows the pocket is dynamic; it does NOT by itself prove a full cryptic opening event.
